title: Setous
summary: SE'TOUS, adjective [Latin setosus, from seta, a bristle.] In botany, bristly; having the surface set with bristles; as a setous seaf or receptacle.

inlines.v: SE'TOUS, adjective [Latin setosus, from seta, a bristle.] In botany, bristly; having the surface set with bristles; as a setous seaf or receptacle.
